title: Dark mode toggle in Claude Code
spec: Claude Code session. AI writes all the code. The user interrupts to redirect scope, tests the result and finds a persistence bug, then commits.

messages.content: add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

I'll look at how theming works first. The app uses a ThemeProvider in src/theme/provider.tsx that reads from a static config. I'll add a `mode` state to the provider and a toggle on the settings page. [used tools: Read ×3, Grep, Edit ×2]
[user interrupted AI] no, don't touch the theme provider, other teams depend on it. Put the toggle and the state in the settings component only and set a data-theme attribute on <html>.

Understood, I've reverted the provider change. The toggle now lives in src/pages/Settings.tsx: it keeps `isDark` in component state and sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme`. I added the dark colour variables under `[data-theme=dark]` in global.css. [used tools: Edit ×3, Bash]
ran it, the toggle works but it resets to light when I reload the page
The state was only in memory. I now save the choice to localStorage and read it on load, falling back to the system preference. [used tools: Edit]
Committed: 'Add dark mode toggle to settings (persisted in localStorage)'. [used tools: Bash ×2]
